title: List_of_R_software_and_tools
summary: A comprehensive catalog of software and programming tools for the R programming language, including IDEs, package managers, libraries, debugging tools, numerical and scientific computing tools, and related projects. Notable entries include Emacs Speaks Statistics (ESS), the Tidyverse collection (ggplot2, dplyr), parallel computing tools (BiocParallel, doParallel, foreach, future, Rmpi), and machine learning packages (mlbench, tidymodels). R is a programming language for statistical computing and data visualization widely adopted in data mining, bioinformatics, and data science. As of mid-2025, CRAN has 90 mirrors and 22,390 contributed packages.
